In this what-if simulation, a ramp at an unnamed set of steps would raise the number of confirmed wheelchair journeys from 1 to 3 across the 5 sampled journeys. The number that reach a destination stays at 3 (reach before 3, reach after 3).
Worth knowing:

• Segment facts are demo values, not yet surveyed.
• The Island hut trip and the unmapped destination from Car Park B still have no mapped connection (data gap), with or without the ramp.

text:
The indicative model marks River +3 m as the level where your trip from Urban Park playground to the nearest evacuation centre breaks. At normal level and River +1 m the route is reached. From River +3 m the start point is likely flooded, so the trip breaks there. The nearest centre is a community hall that is only a candidate, not an official PPS. This is an indicative scenario, not a forecast.
Worth knowing:
• Indicative scenario, not a forecast; River stages are not water depths.
• The start point (Urban Park playground) is likely flooded from River +3 m, which is why the trip breaks there.
• Route data are demo values, not yet surveyed.
• The nearest centre is a candidate (not an official PPS). Follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance.

text:
In this indicative simulation, residents reaching the nearest evacuation centre drop from 4 of 5 origins at normal level to 3 at River +3 m and 1 at River +5 m. The same pattern applies to the stroller, wheelchair and older-adult profiles, with 5 sample origins each. Urban Park playground is the first origin cut off, at River +3 m.
Worth knowing:
• Indicative simulation, not a forecast. River stages are scenarios, not water depths.
• Departure times, warnings and crowding are not modelled.
• Route confirmations rest on demo values, not yet surveyed.
• Follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance.
